┌─ Help: The mouse and the sidebar ────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ The mouse                                                                    │
│   Option-click ground walk there; the server plans the route, inside this zo…│
│                     (a plain click never moves you)                          │
│   Option-click mob  walk up to it, following it, and start attacking (Esc    │
│                     cancels)                                                 │
│   Option-click person, loot walk up and talk, or pick it up                  │
│   Option-click marker walk to it (a scout point, a world event's mark)       │
│   Click mob, person select it and open its card (a click one cell off        │
│                     counts); click again (or F to attack, G to talk) to act  │
│   Click loot        pick up everything within reach; farther away it says    │
│                     how far                                                  │
│   W                 walk to the selected target, or to the last spot         │
│                     clicked: for a terminal that sends no Option-click       │
│   Hover             its name beside the pointer: a mob, person, door,        │
│                     marker, or you; on the large map the places there (the   │
│                     arrow keys' cursor does the same)                        │
│   Alt, Ctrl+A       name everything on the map (Ctrl+A if your terminal      │
│                     sends no Alt with the mouse)                             │
│   Wheel, + -        zoom the map (the wheel over the Events, Chat or Party   │
│ Page 3 of 10  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
